strategy_roster.name: Crossing of Two iMA
strategy_roster.notes: Donchian/breakout reference translated with prior-bar 20-bar channel bounds to avoid current-bar look-ahead. Additional unsupported stateful filters are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Dubic EMA
strategy_roster.notes: ATR/volatility reference translated using current-period ATR relative to its rolling average; absolute price-step risk controls are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Trix Candle
strategy_roster.notes: Moving-average reference translated with inferred/default periods 10/30; unsupported shifts, recursive state, or execution rules are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Bykov Trend
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R is expressed from the rolling high/low range using the DSL primitives; vendor-specific smoothing/state is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Momentum Rev Vol
strategy_roster.notes: RSI reference translated with period 14 and documented/default thresholds; platform-specific oscillator variants are simplified.

strategy_roster.name: SMA Pullback + ATR Exits
strategy_roster.notes: ATR/volatility reference translated using current-period ATR relative to its rolling average; absolute price-step risk controls are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Robot ADX + 2 MA
strategy_roster.notes: ADX/trend reference translated to an OHLCV-compatible trend filter; unsupported directional-index/state logic is simplified.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Trend
strategy_roster.notes: ATR/volatility reference translated using ATR versus its rolling average; absolute point/pip risk controls are not encoded.

strategy_roster.name: Auto KD Crossover
strategy_roster.notes: Stochastic/KD is approximated from the close position in the rolling high/low range because the DSL has no dedicated stochastic function.

strategy_roster.name: Proffessor v3
strategy_roster.notes: Reference strategy is not expressible as a deterministic single-security OHLCV entry signal in the TASI DSL; a never-true guard is used rather than fabricating a signal. Unsupported schedule, portfolio, order-management, external-data, or multi-order mechanics are not represented.
